violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw beef was being stored in the TRUE 2DR UPR cooler above cooked foods and kimchi.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT RAW FOOD CANNOT BE STORED ABOVE READY TO EAT FOODS IN ORDER TO PREVENT POTENTIAL CONTAMINATION. PIC MOVED RAW BEEF BELOW THE COOKED FOODS IN THE COOLER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Safe Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not safe: facility was using multiple garlic containers to store food items that are not garlic.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be safe. PIC NOW UNDERSTANDS THAT THE GARLIC CONTAINERS CANNOT BE USED FOR STORING FOOD ONCE ALL THE GARLIC IS GONE. FOOD CAN ONLY BE STORED IN APPROVED CONTAINERS THAT ARE FOOD GRADE. EHS SHOWED PIC WHERE THEY CAN ORDER FOOD GRADE SAFE CONTAINERS AND PIC ORDERED SOME TO BEGIN STORING FOODS PROPERLY.
